learning_outcomes.text: Demonstrate the ability to analyze and synthesize
Acquire the ability to effectively solve problems
Express oneself correctly in Spanish, both orally and in writing
Develop the ability to transmit information, ideas, problems, and solutions to both specialized and non-specialized audiences
Develop interpersonal skills
Develop the ability to work in a team
Ability to apply knowledge to practice
Acquire the ability for autonomous learning and concern for knowledge and continuous training
Ability to work autonomously
Basic knowledge of production and manufacturing systems
Applied knowledge of manufacturing systems and processes, metrology, and quality control

Ability to draft and develop projects in the field of mechanical engineering, for the construction, reform, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical installations, industrial installations and plants, and manufacturing processes.
Ability to manage activities subject to the engineering projects described in the previous section
Ability to practice teaching in the terms required by current regulations
Know milling machines
Know the geometry of milling cutters
Select the milling cutter according to the material to be machined and the operation to be performed
Calculate cutting speed, cutting forces, and power consumption in milling
Calculate feed in milling to obtain surface quality
Calculate cutting times in milling
Know drilling machines
Know the geometry of drills
Select feed, cutting speed, and cooling to use in drilling
Know broaching machines
Know the geometry of broaches
Design broaches for achieving a specific geometry
Know sawing machines
Know the different types of saws
Select cutting conditions in sawing
Know grinders and grinding machines
Know the identifying characteristics of grinding wheels
Select the characteristics the grinding wheel must have based on the work material
Select cutting conditions in grinding
Know the behavior of fluids in machines
Know the hydraulic valves used in machines
Design hydraulic circuits in machines
Interpret hydraulic circuits of machines

syllabus_topics: Universal milling machine with orientable table
Kinematic chain of the horizontal milling machine
Description of the elements that characterize the milling machine
The milling cutter tool and the milling operation
Minimum cost or maximum economy speed
Number of teeth in contact with the workpiece
Vertical dividing attachment or circular table
Description and types of broaching machines
Rules for selecting a grinding wheel
Cutting forces and cutting power in grinding
Choice and influence of cutting conditions on grinding wheel behavior
How a pump is loaded: cavitation
Classification by number of ways and positions
Types of centers, drains, and pilotings
teaching_methods: Completion of assignments, reports, memoirs, and evaluation tests
assessment_rules: To pass the course, a minimum score of 40% is required in each component and an overall score greater than 50%. For students participating in the Cantera University program, grades are based on assigned tasks. For exchange students, the evaluation system may be modified if academic calendars do not coincide.
